newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly down on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly down on strong yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower on Thursday, reflecting the yen's gains against the dollar, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.1 yen lower to 0.2 yen higher, with benchmark April down 1.1 yen at 142.9 yen.

Local investors rushed to sell from the morning session, discouraged by the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said. Some investors bought on the drop in domestic rubber stocks, but market sentiment was basically bearish today, they said. "But the price falls were smaller than we expected, given the yen's gains today," a trader said.
